title: iris nudicaulis var. clusiana
intro: Iris nudicaulis var. clusiana, commonly known as  Clusiana Iris, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the iris family and is native to Europe. Clusiana Iris is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Clusiana Iris include soothing and calming effects, which can be beneficial for stress relief and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Clusiana Iris include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
